title: Ext 090 — Attested actor tokens: join the identity seam's two halves
description: The RFC 8693 actor_token today asserts the gateway via a copyable client secret. This extension joins 010's user-half exchange with 040/070's attested workload identity (JWT-SVID or Dapr Sentry JWT as actor_token, or X.509-SVID as mTLS client cert per RFC 8705) so act is cryptographically attested, not asserted. Same shape as Red Hat Kagenti (2026-06) and IETF WIMSE. Spec: extensions/090-attested-actor-token/README.md.

title: Ext 070 — Dapr Workflow + Dapr Agents: durable grants, ephemeral tokens
description: Coding-agent loop as durable activities; grant is the durable artifact, tokens minted per-use in-activity, never in history; deliberate expired-token-replay exhibit; crash-resume vs base dispatcher control. Spec: extensions/070-dapr-durable-agents/README.md.

title: Ext 030 — Typed intent (RFC 9396 RAR) enforced at the MCP tool boundary
description: authorization_details bind initiate_return to one order_id/amount; enforcement shim at MCP server (custom by spec); run_python shows the containment limit. Spec: extensions/030-typed-intent-rar/README.md.

title: Ext 020 — Floci un-substitution: Cognito + DynamoDB + Bedrock, verbatim upstream code
description: Restore workshop's verbatim AWS code paths against Floci emulation, seam by seam (identity, datastore, model), one commit+verify each. Spike first: what Floci Bedrock Runtime answers with / Ollama backing. Spec: extensions/020-floci-cloud/README.md.

title: Ext 010 — Token exchange (RFC 8693) at agentgateway backendAuth
description: Gateway trades inbound persona token for narrow per-tool token; actor_token chain visible in Langfuse. Keycloak >=26.2. Spec: extensions/010-token-exchange/README.md. Recommended first: smallest lift, fills the gap TALK.md names.

title: [epic] Workshop extensions — compose past the base
description: Composition layer over the frozen base workshop: each extension swaps one named seam (model/datastore/identity/tool-gateway/secrets/orchestration/grant-shape/observability); different seams compose, same seam = alternatives. Specced in extensions/README.md. Compounding demo: 010 -> 030 -> 070. Migrated from llm-wiki-2sv on 2026-09-15 (this repo's own tracker now exists).

title: Share this repo: add GitHub collaborators (awaiting usernames from Allen)
description: Allen chose 'invite specific people' over making the repo public. Blocked on him supplying GitHub usernames + access level; then add via 'gh repo add-collaborator'/'gh api'. Repo confirmed clean of secrets (history-scanned 2026-09-11). Migrated from llm-wiki-2n0 on 2026-09-15.

title: Ext 080 — Arize Phoenix as trace backend + eval harness (observability seam)
description: Swap Langfuse for Phoenix behind the same OTel collector (dual-write compare, then flip back to dual-write as the end state); re-verify the 26-observation joined trace; datasets-from-traces + experiment scoring local-fast vs local-smart. Spec: extensions/080-phoenix-observability/README.md.

title: Ext 060 — OpenBao secrets plane; dispatcher mint/revoke becomes leases
description: Migrate static K8s Secrets, then per-run Gitea tokens as OpenBao leases; TTL-expiry demo. Spec: extensions/060-openbao-secrets/README.md.

title: Ext 050 — Pomerium as alternate MCP gateway (two-token OAuth 2.1)
description: Same MCP server/personas, second authz architecture; reproduce the lab-4 matrix, document hide-vs-refuse. Spec: extensions/050-pomerium-mcp-gateway/README.md.

title: Ext 040 — SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity + mTLS between all base workloads
description: SPIRE-issued SVIDs replace shared-cluster trust; optional JWT-SVID as subject_token into 010. Spec: extensions/040-spiffe-workload-identity/README.md.
